method.measured: M: observed API execution intervals, PR timelines and pilot receipts

matchedOptimistic.note: Matched final successful merge run only; current dependency graph, same execution duration, all start/scheduling wait removed. Not a Team forecast.

pilot.armNotes: OnBegin-to-OnEnd reporter time; command wall includes server/setup overhead. One candidate run each. CPU differs for four workers; effect is confounded. Aggregate peak memory not measured.
